## name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for QuantScript
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. "I'm frustrated when ..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Privacy / local-first considerations**  
QuantScript is local-first and offline-by-default. Please note any network or data-handling implications of your request.

**Additional context**
Anything else that might help.
